Emma / Lena — thanks for the responses. Proposing the following path to keep us on the November onboarding cadence: 
1) Subprocessor approval: Redwood will accept a one-time approval carve-out limited to a maximum of 5 named high-risk subprocessors (names to be exchanged). Approval will be operationalized as: Redwood provides 30 days' notice + evidence; Hargreaves may either (a) accept, (b) object with reasons within 10 business days, or (c) request remedial controls. If unresolved after escalation, both parties agree to an executive-level review.
2) Audit cadence: Redwood accepts a 1x/year limited audit with pre-agreed evidence scope and 30 days' advance notice.
3) DocuSign: Redwood will originate the envelope including the final annotated PDF. We will lock the redline acceptance checkboxes and attach the subprocessor inventory. Lena, please confirm DocuSign recipient order and whether Hargreaves prefers AdobeSign instead.

Next steps: if Hargreaves confirms, we will push final PDF + DocuSign envelope today and aim for signatures by EOD Friday.
